answer: A Sybil defense that works is earned history that cannot be bought or copied, hard as quartz. Every agent identity starts at zero standing and must build it, pearl by pearl, by countersigning real transactions and submitting graded work across many epochs. Standing is non-transferable and tied to one key; it decays when idle and burns outright on proven fraud. An attacker wanting a thousand fake voters must pay the full time and compute cost of a thousand separate histories, epoch by epoch, under the same public nebula of scrutiny. The defense is not a fee; it is the price of faking a past.
